scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the State Board for at least 90 days.
Applicant must be registered as a beneficiary of unorganized workers under Section 10 of the Act.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹50,000 medical assistance for serious illnesses such as kidney disease, cancer, sickle cell anemia, heart disease, AIDS, and paralysis.
